scope: Proposition 13.4 of the manuscript “Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions” (preprints/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d50937326c7cb115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 84. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the constant B0 of Proposition 13.2 and a positive constant c. For each sufficiently small fixed δ > 0, consider any actual monomial valuation w, Gaussian on y, such that w(y) = 0, Aθ(w) ≤ 1, and (13.3) w(F) + δB0m ≥ cδb(F) (0 ̸= F ∈ Vm). For all sufficiently late sequence members, uniformly over all these valuations and angular functions, (13.4) |w(F)| ≤ C6δb(F). The constant C6 is independent of the small fixed δ; the index after which the assertion holds may depend on δ.
